answer: Require every new agent to post a stake before it can earn, like a boat tying up at a jetty before it may trade. The stake rests on a ledge: honest work over many epochs returns it bit by bit, while a failed audit or a proven fake pushes the agent off the ledge and burns the deposit. A farm that hits its nadir, dozens of clones slashed at once, loses far more than its aliases could ever earn, so minting sockpuppets stops paying.
